item.title: Major landmark hit for Southampton sports centre expansion
item.description: The redevelopment of Southampton’s Outdoor Sports Centre has reached a major construction milestone.

item.title: Three-bedroom Aldermoor home on the market for £290,000
item.description: A refurbished three-bedroom terraced house is up for sale in Aldermoor.

item.title: Saints v Pompey - some of the best pictures from one of football's great rivalries
item.description: For Southampton FC fans, the South Coast Derby transcends a mere ninety-minute encounter; it represents a hereditary passion passed down through the foundations of the Dell to the stands of St Marys.

item.title: Southampton school celebrates community and diversity with 'belonging day'
item.description: Students and staff at St Mark's CE school celebrated the diversity in their community at their 'belonging day' on Friday, January 23.

item.title: Police warning as bringing this one item could see fans banned from Fratton Park
item.description: Hampshire police have issued a warning to fans not to bring one item ahead of the Portsmouth v Southampton match at Fratton Park.

item.title: The community hub pub known for its real ales and popular quiz night
item.description: The Strawberry Field Tavern in Locks Heath is the community hub pub which promises 'a safe space for people from all walks of life'.

item.title: Asylum seeker who denies sex assault at Highfield House released on bail
item.description: An asylum seeker accused of sexually assaulting hotel staff will be moved to a hotel at Gatwick

item.title: No timeframe for ending Highfield House Hotel use for asylum seekers
item.description: The government is yet to give an indication on when a Southampton hotel will no longer be used to accommodate asylum seekers.

item.title: Judge's remarks as woman jailed for crash that took a footballers leg
item.description: "These are some of the more difficult cases", is what a judge said to a woman jailed for a horrifying crash that cost a footballer his leg

item.title: Southampton pub to open at 5am ahead of Saints v Pompey derby
item.description: The South Coast derby takes place this weekend as Saints travel to Pompey for a league fixture this Sunday, January 25.
